disclosuresCashBody:
Phantom Cash enables interaction between stablecoins and third parties through Phantom's interface. Phantom Cash products are provided in partnership with third-party financial service providers, and your use is subject to their terms and conditions in addition to Phantom's Terms of Use. To use Phantom Cash, you are required to complete identity verification (KYC) which is collected and stored by our third-party partners; Phantom does not retain your KYC. Your personal information may also be shared with third-party partners to enable Cash functionality, prevent fraud, and comply with legal obligations, as described in our Privacy Policy.
When you access Phantom Cash on a new device, you may be required to complete additional verification to protect your linked payment methods and bank accounts. Digital assets held in your self-custody wallet, including stablecoins, are under your control at all times. Phantom does not have access to your wallet or the assets within it and cannot reverse, cancel, or modify on-chain transactions. If your recovery phrase is lost or compromised, your funds may be permanently unrecoverable.
